description:
Witness how the Great Fire of London in 1666 reduced a medieval maze of wooden houses to ashes and forever changed urban planning.

Discover how a tiny spark in a Pudding Lane bakery triggered a four-day firestorm, why authorities hesitated to stop it, and how gunpowder eventually saved the rest of the city.
